# Inline lucide icons (https://lucide.dev/icons/), all on a 24-point grid with a 2-point stroke.

export type IconName =
  | 'arrow-right' | 'arrow-tool' | 'callout' | 'check' | 'circle' | 'clipboard' | 'copy'
  | 'crop' | 'crosshair' | 'download' | 'github' | 'heart' | 'highlighter' | 'history'
  | 'keyboard' | 'line' | 'lock' | 'mic' | 'monitor' | 'moon' | 'pen' | 'pipette'
  | 'pixelate' | 'pointer' | 'scroll' | 'shield' | 'square' | 'sun' | 'terminal' | 'text'
  | 'video' | 'window'

export Icon = component extends svg
  @name: IconName
  @strokeWidth?: number := 2
  render
    svg
      viewBox: '0 0 24 24'
      fill: 'none'
      stroke: 'currentColor'
      stroke-width: strokeWidth
      stroke-linecap: 'round'
      stroke-linejoin: 'round'
      aria-hidden: 'true'
      switch name
        when 'arrow-right'
          path d: 'M5 12h14'
          path d: 'm12 5 7 7-7 7'
        when 'arrow-tool'
          path d: 'M7 17 17 7'
          path d: 'M7 7h10v10'
        when 'callout'
          path d: 'M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z'
          path d: 'M13 8H7'
          path d: 'M17 12H7'
        when 'check'
          path d: 'M20 6 9 17l-5-5'
        when 'circle'
          circle cx: 12, cy: 12, r: 9
        when 'clipboard'
          rect x: 8, y: 2, width: 8, height: 4, rx: 1
          path d: 'M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2'
          path d: 'm9 14 2 2 4-4'
        when 'copy'
          rect x: 8, y: 8, width: 14, height: 14, rx: 2
          path d: 'M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2'
        when 'crop'

# The page's pictures of Shotts at work, drawn in HTML and SVG rather than screenshots, so they
# stay sharp at any size and follow the theme. Sizes are in container units (cqw), so each
# picture scales as one.

import { Icon } from './icon.rip'

# A window's top bar: the three traffic lights.
Lights = component
  render
    div class: 'flex gap-[0.6cqw]'
      span class: 'size-[1.1cqw] rounded-full bg-[#ff5f57]'
      span class: 'size-[1.1cqw] rounded-full bg-[#febc2e]'
      span class: 'size-[1.1cqw] rounded-full bg-[#28c840]'

# A page of something worth capturing: a heading, a chart, and lines of text.
Content = component
  render
    div class: 'flex h-full flex-col gap-[1.4cqw] p-[2.2cqw]'
      div class: 'h-[1.8cqw] w-2/5 rounded-full bg-primary/80'
      div class: 'h-[1cqw] w-3/5 rounded-full bg-tertiary/40'
      div class: 'mt-[0.8cqw] flex flex-1 items-end gap-[1.2cqw] rounded-[1cqw] bg-muted p-[1.6cqw]'
        for h, i in [38, 62, 45, 80, 58, 92, 70]
          div
            class: ['flex-1 rounded-t-[0.5cqw]', if i is 5 then 'bg-blue-brand' else 'bg-blue-brand/35']
            style: "height: #{h}%"
      div class: 'h-[0.9cqw] w-full rounded-full bg-tertiary/30'
      div class: 'h-[0.9cqw] w-11/12 rounded-full bg-tertiary/30'
      div class: 'h-[0.9cqw] w-4/5 rounded-full bg-tertiary/30'

        span class: 'font-semibold', 'Finder'
        div class: 'flex items-center gap-[1.6cqw]'
          Icon name: 'crosshair', class: 'size-[1.8cqw]'

import { Icon } from './icon.rip'

# A key as macOS draws one in its menus: F10, ⇧⌘2, ⌥.
export Kbd = component
  render
    kbd class: 'inline-flex min-w-[1.6em] items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-strong border-b-2 bg-surface px-1.5 py-px font-sans text-[0.85em] font-semibold text-primary shadow-xs'
      slot

# A command to paste into Terminal, with a button that copies it.
export Command = component
  @text: string
  @prompt?: boolean := true
  copied := false

  copy: ->
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
    copied = true
    setTimeout((-> copied = false), 1600)

  render
    div class: 'group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-code py-3 pr-2 pl-4 font-mono text-sm text-white/90 shadow-lg'
      if prompt
        span class: 'select-none text-cyan-brand', '$'
      code class: 'min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap', text
      button
        type: 'button'
        class: 'flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-white/60 transition hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white'
        aria-label: if copied then 'Copied' else 'Copy the command'
        @click: copy
        Icon name: (if copied then 'check' else 'copy'), class: 'size-4'

# A section's eyebrow, title, and words under it.
export Heading = component
  @eyebrow: string
  @title: string
  @lead?: string
  render
    div class: 'mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center'
      p class: 'text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide text-accent uppercase', eyebrow
      h2 class: 'mt-3 font-display text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-balance sm:text-4xl', title
      if lead
        p class: 'mt-4 text-lg text-pretty text-secondary', lead

# One feature: an icon in a soft tile, a title, and a sentence or two.
export Feature = component
  @icon: string
  @title: string
  @text: string
  render
    div class: 'rounded-2xl border border-surface bg-surface p-6 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-strong hover:shadow-lg'
      div class: 'flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent-soft text-accent'
        Icon name: icon, class: 'size-5'
      h3 class: 'mt-4 font-semibold', title
      p class: 'mt-2 text-sm/6 text-secondary', text

# Light or dark: the head of the page set one already, and this switches and remembers it.
export ThemeToggle = component
  theme := document.documentElement.dataset.theme or 'light'

  ~> document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme

  toggle: ->
    theme = if theme is 'dark' then 'light' else 'dark'
    try localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)

  render
    button
      type: 'button'
      class: 'flex size-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-tertiary transition hover:bg-muted hover:text-primary'
      aria-label: if theme is 'dark' then 'Switch to the light theme' else 'Switch to the dark theme'
      @click: toggle
      Icon name: (if theme is 'dark' then 'sun' else 'moon'), class: 'size-4.5'
